statement: In Gemma 4 E2B (google/gemma-4-E2B-it rev 3e22461, transformers 5.20.2), residual-stream states of non-final positions entering any layer >= 15 have exactly zero causal effect on final-position logits; perturbations entering layers <= 14 do affect them.
scope: Gemma 4 E2B text decoder, inputs shorter than the 512-token sliding window, no KV cache, fp32 compute; implementation in transformers 5.20.2

supporting_evidence.summary: Gaussian noise (sd 50) on all non-final positions: max|Δlogit| = 0.0 at layers 15/16/25/34 vs 17.7-36.4 at layers 5/13/14; 2 prompts; identical in two separate runs
code: layers >= num_layers - num_kv_shared_layers (=15) take K/V from shared_kv_states stored by the last non-shared layer of the same type (13 sliding, 14 full)

conditions: 2 prompts (10 and 15 tokens); noise sd 50 per coordinate; Runner hooks at resid_pre
verification_method: Deterministic perturbation test + source-code reading; preregistered as P-ARCH-1 in experiments/E001_arch/PREREG.md
uncertainty: Behaviour with KV cache / generation and inputs longer than the sliding window not tested; a different implementation (e.g. official JAX) could differ only if it diverges from the HF reference.

statement: Running Gemma 4 E2B layers 15-34 on the final position only reproduces full-sequence final-position logits (max |Δ| ≤ 3.6e-5 in fp32) and cut a batched forward from 64.3 s to 29.8 s on the lab host.
scope: Final-position metrics only; inputs ≤ 512 tokens; fp32 compute; 2-vCPU host

supporting_evidence.summary: lastonly_vs_full_maxabs 3.6e-5 and 3.1e-5; speed full 64.32 s vs 29.8 s (8x40 batch)

verification_method: Direct comparison with full run and with HF model() (runner vs HF max|Δ| 1.3e-5-3.9e-5)
uncertainty: Speed-up measured on a shared CPU (subagents active); exact factor is host-dependent.

statement: The google/gemma-4-E2B-it tokenizer does not prepend <bos> by default; without BOS the model's next-token predictions degrade severely (e.g. 'The capital of France is': perplexity 2.3e7 and top-1 ' France' without BOS vs 257 and ' Paris' with BOS).
scope: google/gemma-4-E2B-it tokenizer.json/tokenizer_config.json at rev 3e22461; transformers 5.20.2 AutoTokenizer

supporting_evidence.summary: default_adds_bos=false; 4 prompts, all with large ppl drop when BOS added

uncertainty: Only 4 prompts; chat template path adds BOS itself (generation was coherent).

statement: On a CPU without AVX512_BF16, bf16 storage with fp32 matmuls changes Gemma 4 E2B final logits by up to ~0.9 (max abs) relative to native bf16 compute, without changing the top-1 token on the tested prompts; all causal experiments in this lab use fp32 compute.
scope: 8 prompt variants, IT checkpoint, lab host
uncertainty: Small prompt set; effect on patching metrics not quantified.
